initiate_blade.name: Initiate's Blade
initiate_blade.lore: A teaching blade from the Magic Tower. It remembers every hand that tried to unravel it.

wyrmfang.name: Wyrmfang
wyrmfang.lore: The Initiate's Blade would not be unmade. It woke as a dragon-hilted fang and chose its master.

hellbrand.name: Hellbrand
hellbrand.lore: Torn from the Balrog King's burning fist. Its runes still smoulder with the fires of the Tower of Hell.

nightfall.name: Nightfall
nightfall.lore: Forged in the long night beneath the frozen crypts, then carried south by Korgath the Ridgebreaker. Its edge drinks the warmth from every wound.

aetherion.name: Aetherion
aetherion.lore: Three stars were caught in its guard when the world was young. Gorvash the Bonecaller tore it from a fallen archmage and bent its starlight to the service of the dead.

hauberk.name: Hauberk
hauberk.lore: A long coat of riveted rings, worn under your armour. Whatever your armour leaves bare, the hauberk still covers.

flux_stone.name: Flux Stone
flux_stone.lore: A crumbly orange stone that draws slag out of molten metal. Every tier-2 forging needs some.

spirit_salt.name: Spirit Salt
spirit_salt.lore: Pale crystals that form where the dead linger. Binds tier-2 brews and enchantments.

sulfur_bloom.name: Sulfur Bloom
sulfur_bloom.lore: A brittle yellow crust from hell-scorched ground. Distilled into Tempering Oil.

tempering_oil.name: Tempering Oil
tempering_oil.lore: Quenching oil for master forgework. Tier-3 and tier-4 smithing need it. Brewed by the mage.

moonwell_dew.name: Moonwell Dew
moonwell_dew.lore: Dew gathered from enchanted creatures at night. Tier-3 and tier-4 alchemy need it.

starmetal_shard.name: Starmetal Shard
starmetal_shard.lore: A sliver of fallen-star metal, carried only by the mightiest foes. Every tier-4 recipe needs it.

sealed_dispatch.name: Sealed Dispatch
sealed_dispatch.lore: A courier's satchel letter, wax seal unbroken.

tainted_grain.name: Tainted Grain
tainted_grain.lore: A fistful of grain flecked with grey rot — and a powder that is not rot.

hollow_token.name: Hollow Token
hollow_token.lore: A blackened coin stamped with an empty crown.

coin_pouch.name: Raider's Coin Pouch
coin_pouch.lore: Heavy with minted city silver. Orcs don't mint coin.

envoy_letter.name: Envoy's Letter
envoy_letter.lore: Sealed terms of truce between the two cities.

forged_letter.name: Forged Letter
forged_letter.lore: The same seal — but the words promise war.

rune_rubbing.name: Rune Rubbing
rune_rubbing.lore: Charcoal on vellum: the old warding runes of the first kingdom.

supply_manifest.name: Supply Manifest
supply_manifest.lore: A quartermaster's list. Some lines don't add up.

vigil_oil.name: Vigil Oil
vigil_oil.lore: Blessed lamp oil for the crypt braziers.

corvane_journal.name: Corvane's Journal
corvane_journal.lore: A soldier's diary that ends in a stranger's handwriting.

sunshard.name: Sunshard
sunshard.lore: A sliver of the Sundered Crown, warm as a hearth.

moonshard.name: Moonshard
moonshard.lore: A sliver of the Sundered Crown, cool as river stone.

wyrmscale_hauberk.name: Wyrmscale Hauberk
wyrmscale_hauberk.lore: Scales from the Black Dragon's own breast, still warm, laced over a hauberk that no forge in Valoria could have made.

ridgebreaker_warplate.name: Ridgebreaker's Warplate
ridgebreaker_warplate.lore: Korgath never wiped the blood from it. Every dent is a story, and every story ended badly for someone else.

cinderplate.name: Balrog's Cinderplate
cinderplate.lore: It glows from within, like a forge banked for the night. Those who strike it feel the heat.

shroud_of_the_bonecaller.name: Shroud of the Bonecaller
shroud_of_the_bonecaller.lore: Woven from grave-silk and the whispers of the dead. It is never quite still.

tigerworm_leggings.name: Tigerworm Hide Leggings
tigerworm_leggings.lore: Banded hide from the great worm. Wear it and the ground itself seems to hurry you along.

abyss_walker_cuisses.name: Cuisses of the Abyss-Walker
abyss_walker_cuisses.lore: Abaddon walked out of the pit in these. The wounds of whoever wears them close by themselves.

frostwyrm_crown.name: Frostwyrm Crown
frostwyrm_crown.lore: Rime never melts from its crest, even by the fire.

hellclaw_grips.name: Hellclaw Grips
hellclaw_grips.lore: Plate fingers capped with Hellclaw's own pincer-tips. Whatever they grip, they pierce.

emberstride_greaves.name: Emberstride Greaves
emberstride_greaves.lore: The Fire Wyvern's talons, hammered flat. Each step leaves a scorch mark.

aegis_of_the_black_wing.name: Aegis of the Black Wing
aegis_of_the_black_wing.lore: A single wing-plate of the Black Dragon, rimmed in iron. Fire slides off it like rain.

bulwark_of_the_abyss.name: Bulwark of the Abyss
bulwark_of_the_abyss.lore: The gate of a prison that held something worse than Abaddon. It still remembers how to keep things in.

frostwall.name: Frostwall
frostwall.lore: Ice from the Wyvern's nest, packed over a kite shield and never melted since.

bone_ward.name: Gorvash's Bone Ward
bone_ward.lore: A ward of knitted ribs. The Bonecaller sang each one into place.

coil_of_the_tigerworm.name: Coil of the Tigerworm
coil_of_the_tigerworm.lore: A tooth of the worm, curled into a ring. It bites back.

hellfire_loop.name: Hellfire Loop
hellfire_loop.lore: A ring of black iron that was once a link of the Balrog King's chain.

band_of_the_wyrm_king.name: Band of the Wyrm King
band_of_the_wyrm_king.lore: The Black Dragon wore it on one claw. On a man's finger it's as heavy as a crown.

heart_of_the_mountain.name: Heart of the Mountain
heart_of_the_mountain.lore: A fist of living stone from the roots of the Highlands. It beats, slowly.

phylactery_of_gorvash.name: Phylactery of Gorvash
phylactery_of_gorvash.lore: The Bonecaller kept a sliver of his soul in it. A sliver is plenty.

ember_of_the_fire_wyvern.name: Ember of the Fire Wyvern
ember_of_the_fire_wyvern.lore: A coal from the Wyvern's throat, caged in gold. It never cools.

passive_tome.name: Tome of the Unbound Path
passive_tome.lore: Reading it opens a door in you that wasn't there before. +1 passive skill point.

refund_orb.name: Orb of Unmaking
refund_orb.lore: Shatter it and every path you've walked is forgotten — all passive skill points are returned.

abyssal_scepter.name: Abyssal Scepter
abyssal_scepter.lore: A rod of black glass from the floor of the Abyss. Spells cast through it come out hungry.

deathknight_helm.name: Deathknight's Helm
deathknight_helm.lore: Gorvash's first champion wore it. He wears it still, in a manner of speaking.

wyrmfire_wraps.name: Wyrmfire Wraps
wyrmfire_wraps.lore: Silk spun around a sliver of dragonfire. Your fingertips smoke when you cast.

rimefang_treads.name: Rimefang Treads
rimefang_treads.lore: Greaves faced with the Wyvern's frozen fangs. They bite into ice and stone alike.

sandspire_seal.name: Sandspire Seal
sandspire_seal.lore: A seal ring of fused desert glass. The sand in it never settles.

wormglass_pendant.name: Wormglass Pendant
wormglass_pendant.lore: A lens of glassy worm-hide that bends light, and spells, around corners.

runestone_of_the_ridge.name: Runestone of the Ridge
runestone_of_the_ridge.lore: Korgath's shamans carved it. Only a mage can hear what it whispers.
